parent_objective: design source generator updates for missing and undercovered source-history families
blocked_by: M1315 reports source-history coverage gaps and under-target family coverage
supersedes: materializing M1315's current 108-pair plan as the expanded corpus

public_gates: M1316 must not use private holdout
M1316 must preserve actor input contract
M1316 must design generator support for missing families
M1316 must define action-divergence acceptance criteria
forbidden_shortcuts: do not fabricate source labels without dynamics
do not materialize non-divergent families as accepted

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs source generator updates after M1315 reports coverage gaps
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: generator design only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design only relabels unsupported families
stop if design omits action-divergence criteria
stop if design expands actor inputs
stop if design routes directly to PPO
fallback_plan: if design is admissible, implement a no-policy source generation smoke
if simulator cannot represent a family, mark it blocked and use supported families only
if source generation scope is too broad, split by family
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1315 coverage gaps require source generator design

admission_evidence: M1315 planned only 108 source pairs and 216 pair-probe groups
M1315 reported 7 unsupported or undercovered families
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one next manifest if source-generation smoke is admitted

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1316 is source-generator design and does not test closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design source families that create matched command-response history divergence for later diagnostics
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1315 corpus expansion plan and coverage-gap report.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If a family cannot create action-level divergence in the simulator, mark it blocked rather than accepting it.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: Source generator updates can be designed to cover the missing M1315 families while preserving human-view actor inputs and action-divergence acceptance criteria.
success_criteria: design lists supported and blocked source families
design defines action-divergence and margin acceptance criteria
design defines no-policy smoke implementation route
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design relabels unsupported families without dynamics
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1316 passes if it designs source generator updates and acceptance criteria without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout use, threshold relaxation, fake labels, or actor-input expansion.
